Name: DrillOnLeftMouseButton
Description: Activate drill, instead of Show Children on left mouse button. Used for backwards compatibility.

Name: StartModuleActive
Description: Activate the start module, i.e. the welcome page

Name: DefaultLanguageID
Description: The default language in the user interface.

Name: UserManagementType
Description: Vilket typ av användare installationen har.

Name: SendMailToUserOnUnknownDeviceLogin
Description: If this setting is set an email will be sent if a user logs into INSIKT from an unknown device.

Name: SyncOrganizationalStructure
Description: Ifall DirectorySync även ska synka organisationsstruktur.

Name: MailServer
Description: IP or Name of SMTP server to use when sending emails.

Name: SubscriptionMailFrom
Description: Sender name

Name: SubscriptionMailReturnAddress
Description: Sender address

Name: ServiceDeadLineInitialNotificationTime
Description: Number of days before task end date service will start sending daily notification mails also user responsible for tasks which are already delayed will receive notifications

Name: IsDirectorySyncEnabled
Description: Aktiverar AD-synkroniseringar.

Name: DirectorySyncInterval
Description: Tidsintervall i millisekunder mellan AD-synkroniseringar eller 0 för att stänga av (900000 = 15 min).

Name: IsWarmUpEnabled
Description: Aktiverar funktionen för att värma upp INSIKT.

Name: WarmUpInterval
Description: Hur ofta i sekunder som tjänsten ska kontakta INSIKT för att hålla igång applikationen.

Name: IsSubscriptionServiceEnabled
Description: Aktiverar prenumerationstjänsten.

Name: IsBatchCommitEnabled
Description: Aktiverar funktionen för batch-skrivning till kub.

Name: BatchCommitIntervalSec
Description: Tidintervall i sekunder mellan batch-skrivningar till kub.

Name: ImpersonateForReportSnapshot
Description: Säger om INSIKT Service ska logga in som (impersonate) användaren som skapade snapshot-schemat när datan läses upp från kuben

Name: ServiceName
Description: The service name used for the Windows service. If there are multiple instances of the service running on the same machine, they must have different names.

Name: IsIndexMaintenanceEnabled
Description: If the index maintenance task should be executed

Name: IndexMaintenanceDatabase
Description: Database on which to perform index maintenance task

Name: ReportErrors
Description: If INSIKTService should report a summary of errors on the installation to VersionTracker every day

Name: LicenseServerUser
Description: The user name of a user with access to the license server

Name: LicenseServerUrl
Description: The url to the license server

Name: IsUpdateLicenseServiceEnabled
Description: Om InsiktService ska uppdatera licensen

Name: UpdateLicenseServiceHour
Description: Vilken timme på dygnet InsiktService ska uppdatera licensen

Name: IsReportMetaDataServiceEnabled
Description: Om InsikService ska rapportera hem metadata

Name: ReportMetaDataServiceHour
Description: Vilken timme på dygnet InsiktService ska rapportera hem metadata

Name: IsAutomaticUpgradeServiceEnabled
Description: A service the upgrades INSIKT to the latest patch when avilable

Name: AutomaticUpgradeServiceHour
Description: Time of day that INSIKT should schedule automatic upgrades

Name: EnableDatabaseBackupPath
Description: Bestämmer om INSIKTConfig tar automatiskt backup vid uppgradering.

Name: DatabaseBackupPath
Description: Lokal sökväg på SQL-servern som används när INSIKTConfig tar automatiskt backup.

Name: TwoFactorAuthenticationConfigurationType
Description: A value of 1 means it is mandatory, all users will have to set it up on login. A value of 2 means it is completely optional. A value of 3 means it is optional but the user will be suggested to set it up.

Name: EnableDescendantSelections
Description: Enable or disable the new report selection method for descendant selections (on level).

Name: InstallerCertificateSubject
Description: The expected certificate subject for installer files.

Name: RefreshSessionAutomatically
Description: Refreshes the user session automatically so that the user isnt logged out after staying inactive for 20 minutes. Note that the user will still be logged out during the night.

Name: UseInteractiveLogon
Description: If set, INSIKT will use LOGON32_LOGON_INTERACTIVE as logon type. Otherwise default is to use LOGON32_LOGON_NETWORK. Note that setting this as true may affect API call performance.

Name: ApplicationURL
Description: The URL to INSIKT. It will be used when generating links to include in emails, for example. This setting only needs to be set when INSIKT itself cannot determine the correct URL.

Name: EnableGridTooltipIndicator
Description: Activate the Excel style tooltip indicator in the grid.

Name: IndexMaintenanceDatabase
Description: Database on which to perform index maintenance task

Name: IndexMaintenanceDatabase
Description: Database on which to perform index maintenance task

Name: LicenseGraceDate
Description: Start date of license grace period

Name: ASAdminUser
Description: Användarnamn till adminanvändare för AS

Name: AzureMapsTenantID
Description: The tenant ID of the azure account

Name: AzureMapsApplicationClientID
Description: The Azure Maps application client ID

Name: AzureMapsAccountClientID
Description: The Azure Maps account client ID
